add-files-hint: Choose where each file goes inside the HUD folder.
ai-error: حدث خطأ أثناء سؤال المساعد. يرجى المحاولة مرة أخرى.
ai-fallback: المساعد غير متاح حاليًا، لذا هذه عناصر تتطابق أسماؤها مع كلماتك:
ai-intro: صف سمة، أو اطلب أفكارًا، أو اذكر ما تحتاج إلى التصدي له. يمكن تجهيز الاقتراحات بنقرة واحدة.
ai-limit: لقد استنفدت حصة الذكاء الاصطناعي لهذا الشهر.
ai-none: المساعد غير متاح حاليًا ولا شيء يطابق كلماتك. جرّب لونًا أو سمة أو اسم سلاح.
ai-placeholder: اطلب سمة أو طريقة للتصدي أو فكرة…
ai-rate: طلبات كثيرة جدًا. انتظر قليلًا ثم حاول مرة أخرى.
ai-try: جرّب أحد هذه، أو اكتب طلبك:
all-clear: No problems in your changed files.
all-clear-all: No problems found in any file.
animations-hint: Run an event from hudanimations to see it play on the preview.
arrange-none: Select two or more panels, or open a block that has panels on this page.
arrange-target_one: Acts on {{count}} panel on this page.
arrange-target_other: Acts on {{count}} panels on this page.
ask-ai-panel: Ask the assistant about this panel
base-error: Could not load the TF2 Default HUD files. Reload to retry.
binary-assets: This is a binary file — manage it in the Assets tab.
binary-file: Binary file; nothing to edit as text.
block-added_one: Added {{count}} panel to "{{name}}". It took on the block’s look; undo reverts that.
block-added_other: Added {{count}} panels to "{{name}}". They took on the block’s look; undo reverts that.
block-apply: Write the block into every panel again
block-none: Nothing to group: those panels are already in other blocks, or not found.
block-select-hint: Shift-click panels in the preview, or Shift-drag a box round them, then make a block.
block-selected_one: {{count}} selected. Shift-click or Shift-drag in the preview to add more.
block-selected_other: {{count}} selected. Shift-click or Shift-drag in the preview to add more.
block-skipped_one: {{label}}: {{count}} panel was already in another block and was left out.
block-skipped_other: {{label}}: {{count}} panels were already in another block and were left out.
cannot-duplicate: Only text files can be duplicated here.
catalog-error: Could not load the item catalog.
code-empty: Open a file from the tree, or double-click a panel in the preview, to edit its source.
color-ai: Suggest a colour with the assistant
color-ai-prompt: Suggest a better colour for the {{what}} of this panel, one that stays readable.
color-cycle: {{name}} cannot point at itself, directly or through another colour.
color-this-element-hint: Choosing a number detaches it from {{name}}.
color-used_one: Also used by {{count}} other place on this page and in the scheme.
color-used_other: Also used by {{count}} other places on this page and in the scheme.
color-used-none: Nothing else on this page uses it.
cp-eyedropper: Pick a colour from the screen
cp-unknown: Not a colour or a scheme colour
customize-desc: تُطبَّق التغييرات على تشكيلتك فور إجرائها.
delete-confirm: You can undo this, or revert the file later to restore the TF2 Default copy.
delete-hud-body: This permanently deletes the HUD, its history and its share links. Forks other people made stay.
delete-loadout-body: It will also disappear from the workshop and any shared links.
download-hud-hint: Extract the folder into Team Fortress 2/tf/custom/.
draft-missing: That draft is no longer on this device.
edit-font-hint: Faces are tried in order; a face with a screen-height window is used only inside it, others scale with the screen.
effect-approx: تعرض المعاينة تأثيرًا بنفس مظهر تأثير اللعبة، لكن جسيمات اللعبة نفسها تختلف في التفاصيل.
effect-load-error: The particle effect could not be loaded.
effect-not-synced: This particle effect has not been synced yet.
export-failed: Could not build the zip. Check your connection and try again.
f-files-body: resource/, scripts/, materials/ and sound/ exactly as the game expects, a changed-files view and per-file diffs against the default HUD.
f-preview-body: Every HUD page laid out with the engine’s own proportional rules, at any resolution, with adjustable health, ammo, class and round state.
f-share-body: Autosave to your account, version history, share links, and a workshop to fork other people’s HUDs.
f-zip-body: Import any HUD zip and download a ready-to-install folder for tf/custom.
hero-body: Edit, preview, test and share custom Team Fortress 2 HUDs without leaving your browser.
history-hint: Ctrl+Z undo · Ctrl+Shift+Z redo · click a step to jump to it
hub-hero-body: Tools for Team Fortress 2 players, right in your browser.
hub-hud-body: Edit every .res file with a live, resolution-accurate preview. Test health, ammo and class states, diff against the default HUD, then download a ready-to-install zip.
hub-loadout-body: Plan weapons, cosmetics, paints, unusual effects and taunts for every class from the game’s live item list. Keep a loadout per class and share your favourites.
hub-play-body: Team Fortress 2 in your browser: join a server, host a room with bots for your friends, or practise offline against bots. All nine classes, the stock weapons and the classic maps.
hub-workshop-body: Browse HUDs and loadouts shared by the community.
hud-ai-applied: تم التطبيق. يمكن التراجع عنه بخطوة واحدة.
hud-ai-chip-match: Make it match the rest of the HUD
hud-ai-chip-theme: Give the whole HUD a dark teal and amber look
hud-ai-error: حدث خطأ أثناء سؤال المساعد. لم يتغير شيء.
hud-ai-intro: صف ما تريده. سترى بالضبط ما سيتغير قبل تطبيق أي شيء.
hud-ai-no-files: لم أستطع تحديد أي جزء من الواجهة يخص ذلك. جرّب تسميته — الصحة أو الذخيرة أو المنظار أو لوحة النتائج — أو لونًا.
hud-ai-nothing: لا شيء في الملفات يحتاج إلى تغيير.
hud-ai-open: اطلب من الذكاء الاصطناعي تعديل الواجهة
hud-ai-skipped_zero: {{count}} suggested change could not be used and was skipped.
hud-ai-skipped_one: تم تخطي تغييرات مقترحة تعذر استخدامها: {{count}}
hud-ai-skipped_two: {{count}} suggested change could not be used and was skipped.
hud-ai-skipped_few: {{count}} suggested change could not be used and was skipped.
hud-ai-skipped_many: {{count}} suggested change could not be used and was skipped.
hud-ai-skipped_other: تم تخطي تغييرات مقترحة تعذر استخدامها: {{count}}
hud-ai-unavailable: المساعد غير متاح حاليًا. لا يزال بإمكانك تغيير الألوان من لوحة النظام اللوني، والمواضع والأحجام من المفتش.
hud-not-found: That HUD could not be found, or you do not have access to it.
imported: Imported {{changed}} changed files ({{same}} matched the default)
include-blocks-hint: Lets this editor restore your blocks when the zip is imported. The game ignores it.
inspector-empty: Click a panel in the preview, or pick one from the outline, to edit its properties.
language-file-bad: That is not a TF2 language file (expected tf_english.txt or similar).
language-hint: Language for #Token labels. Strings come from resource/tf_<language>.txt; English is used when a token is missing.
legal: Team Fortress 2 is a trademark of Valve Corporation. This is an unofficial fan tool.
license-note: Downloads include the LICENSE that comes with the TF2 Default base HUD; see it for the terms that apply.
load-failed: Could not load the HUD. Check your connection and try again.
loadout-missing: That loadout could not be opened.
loadout-not-found: This loadout does not exist or is private.
loadouts-empty: No public loadouts yet — publish the first one!
look-label: Describe a colour look for the assistant
look-note: The player wants the HUD recoloured. Change scheme colours so the whole HUD follows the look they describe.
look-ph: Describe a look: dark teal with amber
model-failed: This model could not be loaded.
model-none: No 3D model for this item yet.
models-3d: Show 3D models and a backpack of items in the panels that use them
no-assets: Nothing here yet. Upload a file or drop one onto the file tree.
no-blocks: No blocks yet. Group panels that should look the same, like all the charge bars.
no-changes-yet: No changes from the TF2 Default HUD yet.
no-loadouts-saved: Nothing saved yet. Build a loadout and press “Save loadout”.
none-saved: Nothing saved yet. Use “Save & share” in the editor.
nothing-to-customize: لا شيء يمكن تخصيصه في هذا العنصر.
opened-as-copy: Opened as your own copy — the original is untouched.
outline-empty: Nothing to show for this page yet.
override-reset: Overrides the block. Click to follow the block again.
palette-ph: Type a command, page or file name
pick-a-slot: Pick a slot on the left to choose an item for it.
play-command: This button runs “{{command}}”, which Play mode does not simulate.
play-mode: Play mode: click buttons and run a little match
player-3d: Show a 3D player behind the HUD
player-unavailable: اللاعب ثلاثي الأبعاد غير متاح بعد.
public-note: Anyone can find, like and copy this loadout.
register-font-hint: Adds the file to CustomFontFiles and a named font to clientscheme.res.
remove-from-block: Remove this panel from the block
replace-hud-body: Importing a zip starts a new project. Your current work stays saved as a draft on this device.
restored: Restored v{{n}} as a new version — reopen the HUD to load it.
revert-all-body: This returns the HUD to the TF2 Default. You can undo it.
save-first: Save once to get share links.
save-loadout-desc: Name it, then choose who can see it. Public loadouts appear in the workshop.
save-share-hint: Keep this HUD in your account, publish it, or send a link.
sc-nudge: Nudge the selected panel by 1 unit
sc-open-file: Open a file to preview it alone
sc-save: Save (to your account when signed in)
scope-changed-body: Just what differs from the TF2 Default HUD — a small patch to layer over another HUD.
scope-full-body: Every file, ready to drop into tf/custom. Recommended.
search-my-loadouts: Search by title or item name
share-hint: A share link opens the latest saved version read-only, even for a private HUD.
shared-none: Nothing is shared yet. Add a property to set it on every panel at once.
sheet-desc: Choose an item for this slot. Close the sheet when you are done.
similar-nearby_one: {{count}} look-alike panel here. Edit them together?
similar-nearby_other: {{count}} look-alike panels here. Edit them together?
sound-hint: Replace a default sound by uploading a file to the same path, e.g.
stack-h: Line up in a row with the gap
stack-v: Line up in a column with the gap
test-in-game-hint: Play a match with this HUD
title: Title
too-big-for-type: {{name}} is larger than {{mb}} MB, the limit for that file type
unknown-item: Item no longer in the game
virtual-hint: Proportional values lay out on a canvas 480 units high; this is its width.
visibility-hint: Unlisted loadouts are reachable by link but not listed in the workshop.
war-paint-preview-approx: تطلي المعاينة السلاح بنمط اللعبة نفسه لهذا الطلاء. الأجزاء العشوائية من النمط تأتي من البذرة هنا، لذا قد تختلف البذرة نفسها عن اللعبة في التفاصيل.
war-paint-unavailable: ستظهر طلاءات الحرب هنا بعد مزامنة ملفات اللعبة.

warn-limit_other: عدد الإكسسوارات المجهّزة: {{count}}؛ والحد المسموح به في اللعبة: {{limit}}.
warn-overlap: يغطي {{a}} و{{b}} الجزء نفسه من الجسم.
